title: Script Accent
description: The live `.sd-title` — the handwritten Joe Hand line the site uses for warmth above or beside a section title ("How to plan your dream trip to Africa…", "We are Trusted"). Accent font family at extra-light, sentence case, never uppercase. It inherits its colour from the section it sits in, so it reads brand-500 on light surfaces and accent-500 on the dark section; set the colour on the heading where a section does not already supply it. `core/post-title` is in scope as well as `core/heading`, because live gives every non-home banner title the same treatment (`body:not(.home) #lsx-banner .container .page-title`) and on a single that title has to stay dynamic — the destinations archive can author it as a heading, the tour single cannot. Core only emits a variation's numbered class for the block types it is registered against, so without `core/post-title` here the class rides along on the markup and resolves to nothing.
